name: reachscan
description: Vet an MCP server before you install it: see what each tool can execute, read, write, and send, using reachscan's static reachability analysis.

interface.longDescription: Runs the reachscan CLI on an MCP server (GitHub URL, PyPI package, or local path) and summarizes what each tool can reach: shell execution, file reads and writes, network sends, secrets, dynamic code. Ends with an install, review, or avoid recommendation based only on the scan findings.
defaultPrompt: Vet this MCP server before I add it: https://github.com/org/some-mcp-server
What can the tools in pypi:some-mcp-package actually do?
